title: What's the point?

replies.author: _DISTRACTION_
replies.body: You will notice that there is a page selector at the bottom of avicus.net/appeals. The vast majority of these pages only contain appeals not made by you, which you do not have permission to view. While some of the pages may contain appeals made by you (and you can certainly look for them), a much easier method to view your own appeals is simply to access them from the punishment list on your profile.
